modalLead: Hotfix after the shared bookmark form — success toasts show real labels again, row tooltips and the preview card include last-opened, Health share menus label correctly, config stays lazy-loaded on a plain visit, legacy layout/display deep links open Appearance, and category edits from Config → Bookmarks reach the server.

items.text: Success and error toasts resolve labels again — formatDashboardLabel() no longer treats a missing dashboard.* key as a hit, so keys such as bookmarkCreated fall through to config.* (dashboard-ui-helpers.js, locales).
Usage lines on rows and the preview card — last-opened-format.js loads with the dashboard shell again, so tooltips show yesterday / 3h ago instead of only the open count (templates/dashboard.html).
Share menu labels before the context-menu module loads — the loader stub answers shareActionLabel() synchronously instead of returning a Promise (dashboard-bookmark-interactions-loader.js).

Config stays lazy-loaded on a plain dashboard visit — repaintOverview() on the loader stub is a no-op until the module exists, so update-notice.js no longer pulls dashboard-config.js in on every load (dashboard-config-loader.js).
Legacy behavior layout/display deep links — #config/behavior/layout and #config/behavior/display redirect to Appearance on cold load (dashboard-config-loader.js).

Editing a bookmark from Config → Bookmarks persists — the modal receives an API copy of the row; saves go through the remote path and update the live grid when the URL matches (dashboard-inline-edit.js).
